name: trmm
signature: void trmm(long m, long n, double alpha, const double *A, double *B)
layout: A is an m x m matrix and B is an m x n matrix, both stored row-major: element (i, j) of a matrix with c columns is at index i*c + j. A is unit lower triangular: its diagonal is taken to be 1 and only the entries below the diagonal (k > i for element (k, i)) are used; all other entries of A hold arbitrary values and must be ignored. B is input and output: it is overwritten with the result. A and B do not overlap. m and n are at least 1.
